title: The ₹10 Chai That Costs ₹14
source: CPI 4.45% July 2026 (Trading Economics); food 5.52% (MoSPI); RBI below-target 16 months; USD/INR 94.82, Nifty 24774→23653 (yfinance 2026-09-08). Chai math: 10×1.0552^6=13.82≈₹14.

beats.speaker: RAVI
beats.vo: Ten rupees. That's what my chai cost in twenty twenty. Look at it now.

beats.speaker: VIKRAM
beats.vo: That's inflation, Ravi. Prices didn't just rise. Your rupee got weaker.

beats.speaker: VIKRAM
beats.vo: Official inflation, four point four five percent. Food? Even more. Five point five.

beats.speaker: VIKRAM
beats.vo: Rule of seventy two. Seventy two divided by four point four five. Prices double in about sixteen years.

beats.speaker: RAVI
beats.vo: Wait. My savings account pays three percent. That's less than inflation?!

beats.speaker: VIKRAM
beats.vo: That's why we invest. The Nifty wobbles. Down four and a half from its high. But over years, equity outruns inflation.

beats.speaker: RAVI
beats.vo: So money just sitting in the bank is slowly... melting.

beats.speaker: VIKRAM
beats.vo: Put it to work, or inflation eats it. Follow for the next story.
